title: Tractable Inference with Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks
abstract: arXiv:2610.29909v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Machine-learning surrogates in computational science often require not only accurate predictions but also expectations, variances, conserved integrals, and normalization constants. Conventional neural networks, including Kolmogorov--Arnold networks (KANs), generally evaluate these quantities through Monte Carlo sampling or multidimensional quadrature, making repeated inference costly, particularly in high dimensions. We introduce KANs with Tractable Operators for Uncertainty and Constraints (TOUCKANs), whose finite-degree polynomial outer functions yield a decomposable sum--product representation. Under factorizing input measures, expectations and higher moments then reduce algebraically to deterministic recursions over one-dimensional leaf integrals. translated_title: 基于Kolmogorov-Arnold网络的可处理推理
translated_abstract: 计算科学中的机器学习代理模型通常不仅需要准确的预测，还需要计算期望、方差、守恒积分和归一化常数。传统神经网络（包括Kolmogorov-Arnold网络，即KAN）一般需要通过蒙特卡洛采样或多维数值求积来评估这些量，导致重复推理的成本高昂，尤其在高维情况下更是如此。我们提出了具有可处理算子的不确定性与约束KAN网络（TOUCKAN），其有限次多项式外函数产生了可分解的和-积表示。在因式分解的输入测度下，期望和高阶矩可通过代数方式化归为对一维叶子积分的确定性递归计算。独立和共享内块两种变体构成了一个参数效率层次结构，且针对其最受约束成员的通用逼近定理证明可扩展至整个类别。
tldr: 该论文提出TOUCKAN，通过为KAN网络引入有限次多项式外函数形成可分解的和-积表示，使期望、高阶矩等统计量能够通过确定性递归精确计算，从而避免了高维场景下昂贵的蒙特卡洛采样。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces TOUCKANs, Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks with finite-degree polynomial outer functions that yield a decomposable sum-product representation, enabling exact algebraic computation of expectations and higher moments via deterministic recursions instead of costly Monte Carlo sampling in high dimensions.
